data.name: Bob
data.message: Heading nav for chart course, then medbay.

data.name: Frank
data.message: Heading to electrical tasks, Charlie want to come?

data.name: Diana
data.message: Heading electrical for my task—want to pair up?

I found Frank's body in storage. Here's my route: I went cafeteria -> electrical -> medbay -> storage -> lower_engine, then came back to storage and found Frank dead. Bob walked in right as I was there — he came from navigation. I reported immediately since Bob was watching me.

I didn't see who killed Frank. I last saw Frank alive at tick 13 entering storage from lower_engine. When I came back from lower_engine at tick 14, he was dead on the floor and Bob entered right after from navigation. Bob, can you account for your route? Navigation is right next to storage, so the timing is suspicious to me.

My route was storage -> lower_engine -> upper_engine -> medbay. I only saw Eve, in medbay at tick 13. I did not see Frank’s body, and I didn’t see Charlie or Bob on my route.

Charlie’s story puts Frank entering storage from lower_engine at tick 13, and then dead by tick 14. Since I was around storage/lower_engine earlier but didn’t see the body, the kill timing sounds very tight. Bob coming from navigation right as Charlie found it is worth questioning, but Charlie also had access to storage/lower_engine in that window, so I don’t think we can clear Charlie just from the report.

I’d like to hear Bob’s exact route and whether Eve can confirm being in medbay with/near me.

I don’t have a hard clear on anyone. My route was lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical, and I didn’t encounter anyone on that route — no Frank, no Bob, no Charlie, no Diana, no Eve. I also didn’t see a body when I passed through storage, so if Charlie found Frank there after that, the kill was after I left storage.

Based on what’s been said, the important window sounds like tick 13 to 14 in storage. Charlie had access to storage and reported, so not automatically clear. Bob coming in from navigation right as the body was found is also definitely worth explaining. Diana’s medbay claim needs Eve to confirm.

I want to hear Bob’s exact route and Eve’s confirmation before voting. Right now I’m suspicious of Bob or possibly a self-report from Charlie, but I don’t think we have enough yet.

I went navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay. I never saw Frank’s body and I didn’t personally cross paths with anyone in a room.

I did see Bob leave security toward navigation around tick 6, so Bob being on the navigation side later does fit what I saw. I also saw Diana leave medbay toward electrical around tick 13, so I can confirm Diana was at/near medbay then, though she should clarify that she went from medbay to electrical after seeing me.

On the kill: if Frank entered storage at tick 13 and was dead by tick 14, that’s a very tight window. Bob coming from navigation into storage sounds suspicious at first, but navigation to storage takes time, so if Charlie is right that Bob arrived from navigation right as the body was found, I’m not sure Bob could have killed Frank in storage immediately before that. Charlie definitely had the closest access by his own route, so I’m more worried about a possible self-report unless Bob’s story has holes. I want Bob’s exact route before voting.

My route was security -> weapons -> back through security -> navigation. I saw Eve at tick 6 in security, coming in from navigation, which matches her saying she was on that side. I didn’t see Frank, Charlie, Diana, or Alice at all during my route.

I was on the navigation side before the report, so I did not have access to storage in that tick 13-14 window unless I’d already been there, which I wasn’t. Navigation to storage takes time, so Charlie saying I came from navigation actually makes it harder for me to have killed Frank in storage right before the report.

The tight timing makes me most suspicious of Charlie here. He says he saw Frank enter storage at tick 13, then came back and found him dead by tick 14. That means Charlie was the closest person by his own story, and reporting doesn’t clear him. I’m leaning Charlie self-report unless there’s something I’m missing.

Quick clarifications since several of you have questions:

My exact route again: cafeteria (tick 9-10) -> electrical (11) -> medbay (12) -> storage (13, saw Frank enter from lower_engine alive) -> lower_engine (briefly) -> back to storage (14, Frank dead, Bob walked in from navigation).

Bob, I hear you flipping it on me, but think about it: if I killed Frank, why would I go to lower_engine and then come BACK to storage to report? I'd just keep walking and let someone else find him. I reported precisely because Bob saw me standing there — staying silent would've looked terrible.

Eve's testimony actually matters a lot here. Eve, you said you saw Bob leave security toward navigation around tick 6 — that's very early. Bob could easily have gone navigation -> storage and back. Navigation to storage is right there on the map. Bob's claim that "navigation to storage takes time" is misleading — it's a direct connection.

Also, Alice says she passed through storage and saw no body, no Frank. That fits my timeline: Frank was alive in storage at 13, killed between my lower_engine trip and my return.

The two people with real storage access in the kill window are me and Bob. I reported. Bob conveniently arrived "just after." I'm leaning Bob, but I want to hear if anyone can actually place Bob in navigation at tick 13 specifically.

Eve’s confirmation is right: I was in medbay around tick 13 and then went toward electrical. I also saw Eve there, so I think Eve and I can at least place each other away from storage at that time.

I want to focus on the timing. Charlie’s story is that Frank was alive entering storage at tick 13, then dead by tick 14, and Charlie is the one who went storage -> lower_engine -> back to storage in that exact window. Bob arriving from navigation right as the body is reported actually makes Bob less likely to have killed in that tiny window, unless we’re saying Bob somehow killed Frank after Frank entered storage and still came from navigation immediately after, which doesn’t add up well with travel time.

Charlie’s “why would I come back and report” argument doesn’t clear him to me — self-reports happen, especially if Bob walked in and saw him near the body. Right now, based on the tight timing and who had direct access, I’m leaning Charlie over Bob.

I’ll restate my route: lower_engine -> storage -> medbay -> electrical. I didn’t see anyone at all, and when I passed through storage there was no body and no Frank that I saw.

After hearing everyone, I’m leaning Charlie. The key point is Charlie’s own timeline: he says he saw Frank alive entering storage at tick 13, then he went storage -> lower_engine -> back to storage and found Frank dead at tick 14. That puts Charlie directly in the kill window and right next to the body.

Bob is suspicious for arriving from navigation, but navigation to storage is not instant, and if Charlie really saw Frank alive at tick 13, I don’t see how Bob kills him in storage and then “arrives from navigation” right as Charlie reports. Diana and Eve also seem to place each other away from storage around that time.

So unless there’s a detail I’m missing, I think Charlie has the clearest opportunity here.

I’m still on Charlie here.

My info hasn’t changed: I was navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay. I saw Bob leave security toward navigation at tick 6, but that’s way too early to hard-clear him for tick 13-14. I also saw Diana leave medbay toward electrical around tick 13, and Diana confirms seeing me, so I think Diana and I are both away from storage for the key window.

The deciding thing for me is Charlie’s timeline. Charlie is the one placing himself with Frank alive in storage, then leaving and coming back to Frank dead. Bob arriving from navigation right as the body is found doesn’t make sense as the killer in that exact tight window, because he’d have to be in storage to kill but is supposedly entering from navigation.

Also Charlie saying “why would I come back and report” doesn’t clear him — if Bob walked in and saw him near the body, reporting is exactly what a Duck would do to control the story.

Unless someone has a stronger contradiction, I’m voting Charlie.

I agree with the direction here. My route was security -> weapons -> back through security -> navigation, and Eve seeing me leave security toward navigation at tick 6 matches that. I didn’t see Frank at all, and I didn’t see Charlie until the body/report moment in storage.

The key issue is still Charlie’s own timeline: he says Frank was alive in storage at tick 13, then Charlie goes storage -> lower_engine -> back to storage, and Frank is dead at tick 14. That puts Charlie directly next to Frank in the exact kill window. Me coming from navigation into storage right as the body was found doesn’t fit as well for the kill, because I would have had to kill in storage and somehow also be arriving from navigation at the same moment.

Eve and Diana seem to vouch for each other being away from storage, Alice passed through before the body was there, and Frank ended up dead right after Charlie says he saw him alive. I think this is most likely a Charlie self-report, especially if he saw me coming in and wanted to control the story.

I’m voting Charlie.
